title: CVE-2026-34486: Apache Tomcat RCE
summary: [P1] Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor, which can lead to remote code execution. This vulnerability is being exploited in the wild and no patch is currently available. Why now: Reported exploitation in the wild (confidence: 0.90)
classification_reasoning: This vulnerability allows remote code execution, which is a clear case of rce.
